name: Approved Tool Required
description: All tools used in production delivery must exist in the approved enterprise tool registry.

name: Owner Required
description: Each registered tool, platform, and API must have a documented business and technical owner.

name: Cost Center Required
description: All platform assets must be mapped to a cost center for financial accountability.

name: Security Classification Required
description: Assets must define data and security classification before production usage.

name: API Versioning Required
description: All externally consumed APIs must follow enterprise versioning guidelines.

name: Logging and Monitoring Required
description: Production services must emit standard logs and operational telemetry to approved observability tooling.

name: Data Privacy Review Required
description: Any tool or API processing sensitive data must complete privacy and compliance review.

name: Lifecycle Status Required
description: All registry entries must include lifecycle status such as Strategic, Tolerate, Rationalize, or Sunset.
